title: Gentle Shell on Herdr UI
brief: A graphical Gentle Shell built on the open-source Herdr UI with pi underneath, so people who don't use the terminal can run agents. Clean, details on demand, guided; Gentleman Programming identity (mustache, neon pink and violet, Engram elephant, Gentle AI rose). Pixel art (90s adventure look), lo-fi vaporwave, calm; management like FTL/DotAge; no walking characters, every click instant. Rooms are harness functions; project = building, session = floor, subagents named by role (worker, worker-tests…).

artboards.title: The tower, painted (The Dig quality)
artboards.tradeoff: Painted 720x450 pixel art with lighting and a VGA finish; animated people (walk, type, read, check, wave, sip); floor intercom with in-world artifacts (diagram on the map board, plan on the desk, image on the wall) and a viewer. Heaviest to build: needs PixiJS + Aseprite sheets in production.

artboards.title: The tower: project = building, session = floor
artboards.tradeoff: Every project is a building and every session a floor with the same rooms (map, workshop, lab, review, Engram, Gentle AI, lounge); the orchestrator and its named subagents move between rooms. Global state lives in the lobby (door = permissions, bust = persona, switch = review). Most complete; densest picture.

artboards.title: Club = harness (single session)
artboards.tradeoff: Rooms mean harness functions; one session only.

artboards.title: Club cutaway (FTL-style management)
artboards.tradeoff: All projects visible at once as rooms; agents as crew; effort as room power; questions as numbered events; pause all. Calm lo-fi vaporwave pixel art. Dense work still needs the session view.

artboards.title: Pixel club, adventure style
artboards.tradeoff: Lo-fi vaporwave point-and-click: one room, dialogue choices, the marble bust as guide. Warmest; shows fewer projects at once.

artboards.title: The Gentleman Club
artboards.tradeoff: World as the interface with brand identity: rooms per project, Engram library, the bar as usage, the Gentleman as guide. Needs a List view for dense work.

artboards.title: Calm home
artboards.tradeoff: Clean, guided start; no world, little identity.

artboards.title: Calm session
artboards.tradeoff: Conversation first, everything technical folded; candidate for the club's List view.

artboards.title: Night barrio (reference)
artboards.tradeoff: Same world mechanics, generic theme; rejected as not Gentleman.
